name: Tomori
source:
The Goofy Dead Chick

A girl who died and went straight to Hell. Just before she's about to receive her regularly scheduled torture, the script flips and she's pulled into 8246's peculiar scheme as an employee.

[Translated from the official website by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727446488530158011]Steiner[/url]]
